verdict.rationale: Robots.txt is a fair question for any public web service, so the axis applies, but no readable robots policy exists. On 2026-10-27, www.nvsos.gov/robots.txt returned an Akamai 403 and later an Incapsula bot-challenge page, and the ORION portal's robots.txt redirected to an Incapsula noindex shell. An agent therefore cannot learn what it may read before fetching.
